_comment: Maps a furniture type to an external model file, taking priority over the generated .glb library. This is the first step toward the symbol -> model registry described in plans/annotation-symbols-v1.md: annotations never name a model, only a type, so the library can be swapped here without touching a single package. Paths are absolute because these libraries live outside the repo.
_caveat: CGAxis volumes ship room SETS, not single fixtures. cgaxis_models_22_07 is a bath plus vanity plus shower column in one file. Mapping it to 'bathtub' drops the whole set into the room. Acceptable while proving the pipeline; a real bathroom-set symbol is the proper fix.
